reviews.summary: Findings identify incorrect plural handling for unit formatting and related edge cases.

findings.text: format with unit long uses rounded*divisor for plural decision, causing wrong plural for negative and near-threshold values, e.g., -1500ms with unit s yields '-1 seconds' instead of '-1 second'.
Long formatting for non-ms units builds the plural string from rounded*divisor rather than original ms, so pluralisation can be off by one unit boundary.
